Pole vaulter Joe Ive completed a remarkable double at the South of England Athletic Championships at Crystal Palace. The rapidly rising 19-year-old Belgrave Harrier took the Under 20s title on the Saturday and then captured the senior crown on the Sunday.
Joe Ive once again cleared 5m while Cameron Johnson fresh from his final law exams squeezed over in his first competition of the year to gain valuable points in the B.

Joe Ive was disappointed not to gain selection for the World Junior Championships in Beijing and had "packed his season in" a couple of weeks earlier.

Commonwealth Champion Phillips Idowu and Samson Oni set Championship Bests in triple and high jumps, Bernard Yeboah took the long jump while the pole vault saw a 1-2 from Joe Ive and Cameron Johnston.

Joe Ive equalled the winning height in the pole vault but we missed Cameron Johnston who pulled out the day before with a virus. Richard Danso gained a third spot in the long jump and it was a big blow when Darragh O’Farrell failed to appear for the long and triple.
